notes.title: Driver Fusion 7.1 Update Released
notes.content:
Today, we're thrilled to announce the release of Driver Fusion 7.1. This update contains several quality and reliability improvements. Please try out these improvements share your feedback with us, we like to read and use them!

[b]Responsiveness[/b]
In the previous update we've mentioned that switching between features can take some time to render if there's a lot of content loaded, such as the results from driver cleaner. In this update, we've greatly reduced the time and memory usage required to switch between the features. Furthermore, loading driver entries is now completed in almost half of the original time for large drivers.

[b]History[/b]
Viewing the details of an operation now includes a summary on top to make it easier for you to see and remember what you've selected.

[b]Device monitor[/b]
The graphs' axis from top to bottom will no longer always start at zero to make it easier to see small differences. The labels are also more compact to make it possible to draw slightly larger graphs.

[b]Driver cleaner[/b]
The cleanable drivers received new entries to be up-to-date with their latest versions.

notes.title: Driver Fusion 7.0 Update Released
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce the release of Driver Fusion 7.0. With this release, we've made it possible to switch between features without having to start over. Please send your comments and suggestions to us, we like to read and use them!

[b]Usability[/b]
Driver Fusion will now remember the state of your opened features. For example, you no longer have to recheck for issues in health check after you've switched to device control and can immediately return to the results you were looking at. Switching between features can take some time to render if there's a lot of content loaded, such as the results from driver cleaner.

[b]Scheduler[/b]
The scheduler will no longer show a fixed popup at the bottom right corner but instead use an automatically closing Windows notification. On Windows 10, this notification will not be shown if you've enabled Focus Assist. Futhermore, you can change in the settings which issues you want the scheduler to check for.

[b]Health check[/b]
You can uncheck any of the three issue categories again before you're checking for issues.

[b]Device control[/b]
The time required to load devices is greatly reduced and is now completed within a second on most systems. Other features that use devices, such as health check and driver cleaner, also benefit from this change.

[b]Driver cleaner[/b]
The cleanable drivers received new entries to be up-to-date with their latest versions. Searching for entries also take less time, which is especially noticeable for drivers with many possible entries. In addition, we've added support for cleaning UWP apps on Windows 10.

[b]Driver backup[/b]
We've improved support for backing up Universal Windows drivers, which enable developers to create a single driver package that runs across multiple different device types, from embedded systems to tablets and desktop PCs.

[b]Driver cleaner[/b]
The cleanable drivers received new entries to be up-to-date with their latest versions.

[b]High-DPI scaling improvements[/b]
Support for per-monitor scaling has been added and we've increased the rendered resolution of most icons.

[b].NET Framework[/b]
Starting with this release, you need to have at least .NET Framework 4.7.2 installed. Almost everyone will have it installed through Windows Update or otherwise, but if not, then Steam can automatically download and install it for you.

[b]What else?[/b]
We've added support for more devices in device monitor and the issues that you've reported have all been fixed.

notes.title: Driver Fusion 5.6 Update Released
notes.content:

We've added an option in [i]advanced settings[/i] to prevent automatic installation of drivers for specific devices. This will block driver installations for the device on [i]your entire system[/i], including Windows Update, device manager, and third-party installers. All driver installations made through Driver Fusion are unaffected. Together with the option to change the driver installation behavior from Windows Update, you now have full control over driver installations.

[b]New website and logos[/b]
The links used in Driver Fusion have been updated to reflect our [url=https://treexy.com/company/news/brand-new-website/]brand new website[/url]. We've also added a new logo for Driver Fusion.

[b]Driver cleaner[/b]
Experienced users can now select and deselect all entries from a category by right-clicking on the category header.

[b].NET Framework[/b]
Starting with this release, you need to have at least .NET Framework 4.6.2 installed. Almost everyone will have it installed through Windows Update or otherwise, but if not, then our installer can automatically download and install it for you. This newer .NET Framework version enables us to support longer file paths and its performance is also improved.

[b]What else?[/b]
The issues that you've reported have been fixed, such as the issue that some devices aren't correctly identified as disconnected on Windows 7.

notes.title: Driver Fusion 5.5 Update Released
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce the release of Driver Fusion 5.5. With this release, we’re providing a major update to Driver Fusion and its web service. Please send your comments and suggestions to us, we like to read and use them!

[b]Health check[/b]
You can now search for drivers that typically require a deeper understanding of drivers. For example, storage controller drivers were never searched for and you would need to download drivers for these devices through [i]device control[/i]. This change is opt-in, you first need to enable these drivers by accessing the search options on top. 

Furthermore, you can now delete all [i]disconnected devices[/i] - also known as unused, ghosted or phantom devices - in health check. The number of these devices continues to grow after you've used Windows for a while, and this can reduce your boot time and the loading time of your devices. If you've deleted a device and ever reconnect it again then Windows will still automatically install it for you.

[b]Scheduler[/b]
Much like antivirus software runs periodic scans of your system, you can now run periodic scans of issues in [i]health check[/i] as well. This automated feature is convenient and gives you peace of mind, as all you ever have to do is fix the issues whenever Driver Fusion tells you an issue is detected. A check is performed every two weeks by default, but you can choose from four different intervals in the settings.

[b]Web service[/b]
If you scan for [i]driver updates[/i] in Driver Fusion, it will now detect drivers a lot faster (nearly four times as fast!). The number of drivers that can be found has also been doubled for most computers. We've also improved which drivers are suggested, giving you not only access to newer drivers, but also how these drivers are matched against your devices. Previously, a driver that originated from another manufacturer could've been suggested (this is also done by Microsoft's Windows Update and competitor products). We're now actively filtering these generic drivers out. This ensures that you receive better drivers.

We continue to check all drivers before we make them available, in order to provide you with drivers that are safe and working correctly. A driver that isn't up to our standards will not be suggested by Driver Fusion.

In [i]device identifier[/i] you will find results that are more closely related to your devices. This is very noticeable for devices that are closely related to each other, such as GPUs that are merely rebadged.

[b]Driver cleaner[/b]
We've added a percentage while loading the software and driver entries, in order to make it easier for you to find out how long it will take. The entries that can be cleaned have been updated to include the latest driver versions, such as AMD's Radeon Software Adrenalin Edition and NVIDIA's display drivers.

[b]Device control[/b]
The list of devices is now automatically reloaded once a change has been detected, including changes made outside of Driver Fusion. For example, if you connect a device to your computer then device control will automatically reload the devices. The time required to reload has also been greatly reduced. Furthermore, we've increased the number of suggested online drivers.

[b]What else?[/b]
Driver Fusion's memory usage has been slightly reduced and the issues you've reported have been fixed.

notes.title: Driver Fusion 5.5 Update Released
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce the release of Driver Fusion 5.5. With this release, we’re providing a major update to Driver Fusion and its web service. Please send your comments and suggestions to us, we like to read and use them!

[b]Health check[/b]
You can now search for drivers that typically require a deeper understanding of drivers. For example, storage controller drivers were never searched for and you would need to download drivers for these devices through [i]device control[/i]. This change is opt-in, you first need to enable these drivers by accessing the search options on top. 

Furthermore, you can now delete all [i]disconnected devices[/i] - also known as unused, ghosted or phantom devices - in health check. The number of these devices continues to grow after you've used Windows for a while, and this can reduce your boot time and the loading time of your devices. If you've deleted a device and ever reconnect it again then Windows will still automatically install it for you.

[b]Scheduler[/b]
Much like antivirus software runs periodic scans of your system, you can now run periodic scans of issues in [i]health check[/i] as well. This automated feature is convenient and gives you peace of mind, as all you ever have to do is fix the issues whenever Driver Fusion tells you an issue is detected. A check is performed every two weeks by default, but you can choose from four different intervals in the settings.

[b]Web service[/b]
If you scan for [i]driver updates[/i] in Driver Fusion, it will now detect drivers a lot faster (nearly four times as fast!). The number of drivers that can be found has also been doubled for most computers. We've also improved which drivers are suggested, giving you not only access to newer drivers, but also how these drivers are matched against your devices. Previously, a driver that originated from another manufacturer could've been suggested (this is also done by Microsoft's Windows Update and competitor products). We're now actively filtering these generic drivers out. This ensures that you receive better drivers.

We continue to check all drivers before we make them available, in order to provide you with drivers that are safe and working correctly. A driver that isn't up to our standards will not be suggested by Driver Fusion.

In [i]device identifier[/i] you will find results that are more closely related to your devices. This is very noticeable for devices that are closely related to each other, such as GPUs that are merely rebadged.

[b]Driver cleaner[/b]
We've added a percentage while loading the software and driver entries, in order to make it easier for you to find out how long it will take. The entries that can be cleaned have been updated to include the latest driver versions, such as AMD's Radeon Software Adrenalin Edition and NVIDIA's display drivers.

[b]Device control[/b]
The list of devices is now automatically reloaded once a change has been detected, including changes made outside of Driver Fusion. For example, if you connect a device to your computer then device control will automatically reload the devices. The time required to reload has also been greatly reduced. Furthermore, we've increased the number of suggested online drivers.

[b]What else?[/b]
Driver Fusion's memory usage has been slightly reduced and the issues you've reported have been fixed.

notes.title: Driver Fusion 5.1 Update Released
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of Driver Fusion 5.1. In this release, we've worked on a lot of varied areas, making your experience with Driver Fusion better. Please [url=https://treexy.com/about/contact-us/]send[/url] your comments and suggestions to us, we like to read them. We hope you enjoy Driver Fusion 5.1!

[b]Localization[/b]

To provide a localized experience for everyone around the world, we've greatly improved the quality of the supported languages. Our translators have been hard at work to make sure that the majority is now correctly translated. If you are keen on having Driver Fusion translated into your own language, or if you want to improve it, please [url=https://treexy.com/about/contact-us/]contact us[/url].

[b]Steam account[/b]

Driver Fusion now integrates seamlessly with Steam and uses their authentication system to sign you in. This will significantly reduce the number of steps that are required to get started, as you no longer have to activate it with a third party key. All third party keys that have been given out by Steam will be revoked once we are sure that everyone received the update through Steam.

[b]Driver cleaner[/b]

We've always relied on predefined processes and services, that need to be stopped, in order to clean driver entries that are still in use. This works great, until you have something installed that isn't on this list. Driver cleaner is now able to detect which processes and services are using an entry and will automatically stop them before the entry gets cleaned. The stopped processes and services will be restarted once the entry has been cleaned.

[b].NET Framework and operating systems support[/b]

Starting with this release, you need to have at least .NET Framework 4.5.2 installed. Almost everyone will have it installed through Windows Update or otherwise, but if not, then our installer can automatically download and install it for you. This is also the first version that no longer supports Windows XP and Windows Vista. You can continue to use Driver Fusion 5.0 if you rely on these operating systems. The content service behind Driver Fusion will continue to work with it for the foreseeable future.

[b]What else?[/b]

We've added support for more devices - along with additional information - in device monitor. The issues you've reported have been fixed and the start up time has been reduced. Furthermore, you can now easily invite a friend to Driver Fusion.

notes.title: Driver Fusion 5.0.2 Update Released
notes.content:
We’re pleased to present Driver Fusion 5.0! It’s been a while, but we’ve been working hard on bringing you this update. Our mission was to improve the performance, stability, usability and the offered features. You can read the highlights of these improvements below. We hope you like this version as much as we do!

[b]Interface and usability[/b]

We’ve been focusing our efforts on improving the interface and it’s usability and have redesigned almost everything. It’s still familiar to previous versions, so you won’t have to learn from scratch. An important highlight, by popular request, is that you can now search, filter and sort through content, almost everywhere! But that’s not all, it’s also possible to use Driver Fusion 5.0 with just your keyboard. We’ve added focus hints to all controls to make it easy to see where the current focus is. You’ll see how nifty all these changes are once you start using them.

[b]Health check[/b]

Up until now, there were two categories for downloading drivers; missing drivers and outdated drivers. As they did almost the same work, they have been combined into driver update. If you’re checking for driver updates, clarity is essential. We’ve been receiving a lot of feedback on why Driver Fusion is recommending certain drivers. Whenever a recommended driver is not undeniably clear, it will now add an explanation. Still having doubts? Feel free to contact us and we’ll help you out. At times you want to take a closer look at a device or its driver. You can now go directly to the device or its driver in device control. Another frequently requested feature we’ve added is that each recommended issue can now be fixed on its own. Don’t worry, you can still fix all issues at once.

[b]Device control[/b]

Starting with Windows Vista, there’s additional information available about a device or a driver. This information was already used throughout Driver Fusion and has now been added to device control. All available information – including the identifier – is now accessible immediately after selecting a device. Driver Fusion 5.0 also ships with several other important improvements to device control. If you want to install a driver it now includes compatible drivers from Windows’ driver store. For experts, we’ve also added the ability to uninstall a driver from Windows’ driver store. The driver signature verification is also significantly improved, both the results and the performance (on average a driver is now verified twice as fast).

[b]Device monitor[/b]

If you want to monitor your devices, Driver Fusion has always given you a variety of options to do so. The current sensor values are great for getting insight into your devices, but sometimes you want to visualize past performance as well. In Driver Fusion 5.0, we’ve added a graph – for each device – for the available sensor values. It’s super flexible, and will allow you to add just the sensors you want to display. We’ve also added additional information about each device, such as the socket of your processor, the BIOS version of your motherboard, and the reallocated sector count of your hard disks.

[b]Driver cleaner[/b]

Need to clean up old drivers or install a new driver? All drivers received new entries to be up-to-date with their latest versions. We’ve also added support to clean the device itself and entries from the task scheduler and Windows’ driver store. Several new drivers have also been added, including NVIDIA’s GeForce Experience software. In Driver Fusion 5.0 we separated entries that are shared between certain drivers. While cleaning those drivers – such as NVIDIA’s display driver and NVIDIA’s GeForce Experience – you can now decide whether you want to include their shared entries. We’ve also added a hint when drivers are combined by the manufacturer to support multiple devices, such as Logitech’s keyboard and mouse drivers.

[b]History[/b]

Sometimes you want to view or restore an operation you’ve performed in Driver Fusion. Our goal for Driver Fusion 5.0 was to create an easy to use – and complete – history of almost anything you can do. Whether you clean a driver or disable a device, you don’t have to worry anymore about the outcome as you can always undo the operation. In most cases, you want to restore the entire operation. Operations that are merely collection of other operations, such cleaning a driver, can also be restored separately. We’ve also visualized if the operations you performed succeeded.

[i]In driver cleaner: some installers cannot be restored because they are missing on your computer. This is not a limitation of Driver Fusion but due to how Windows or these installers are set-up. You can manually download the installer again.[/i]

[b]Settings and data[/b]

It’s good to have choices, like the ability to change the default preferences of Driver Fusion. In Driver Fusion 5.0 we’ve changed a few default preferences to their expected value. We’ve also combined several settings and – where applicable – extended their functionality throughout the entire application. A diagnostics report for troubleshooting can now be created from the general settings.

To benefit from Windows’ file protection, Driver Fusion will now store its data in different folders. Data that can be shared among all users, such as driver backups, is written to the ProgramData folder. User-specific data, such as your settings, is written to the local AppData folder. This change also enables you to use Driver Fusion in multi-user environments without having to share your settings with everyone. If you want to override this behavior and have Driver Fusion store its data in the installation folder, you have to start Driver Fusion using the --p argument. This does not apply to the Steam edition, data will continue to be stored in the steamapps\common folder in order to utilize Steam Cloud.

[b]Operating systems support[/b]

Driver Fusion 5.0 will be the last update for Windows XP and Windows Vista. Microsoft itself ended support for Windows XP in 2014 and Windows Vista in the beginning of 2017. Unsupported operating systems receive no security updates, have known exploits, and can be dangerous to use. You can continue to use this version of Driver Fusion if you rely on these operating systems. The content service behind Driver Fusion will continue to work for the foreseeable future. We have disabled automatic updates on these operating systems. You do not need to do anything else.

[b]5.0.1 and 5.0.2[/b]

These releases fix some minor issues and change the installer's compression to resolve the installer's false positive detection by certain antivirus software, such as Avast and AVG.

You play an important role in making Driver Fusion better. We welcome your feedback on this version, as well as any ideas you might have. Please contact us on our website.

notes.title: Disable automatic driver updates in Windows 10
notes.content:
One of the most frequently heard complaints about Microsoft's Windows 10 is the forced download and installation of driver updates through Windows Update. In previous versions of Windows you were presented with a list of (driver) updates and could uncheck an update if you wanted to. While this change might seem useful for users that never update their drivers, there are several reasons why you do not want Microsoft to control the drivers that are installed on your computer, such as:
[list][*]You want to use an older driver because it works better.[/*][*]You have software installed that relies on another driver.[/*][*]You encountered system problems caused by the driver from Windows Update.[/*][*]You have a newer driver than the driver provided through Windows Update.[/*][/list]
Because all driver updates are enforced by Microsoft, you cannot roll back to a previous version as Windows Update will download and install the driver again.

With [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/234820]Driver Fusion[/url] you can disable automatic and mandatory driver updates in Windows 10. This feature also works in Windows Vista, 7, 8 and 8.1. Once you have opened Driver Fusion, go to the settings [img]https://treexy.com/media/37940/sphere1_small.png[/img] and select the advanced settings [img]https://treexy.com/media/37941/sphere2_small.png[/img]. You can then change how Windows driver updates are installed by changing the setting in [img]https://treexy.com/media/37942/sphere3_small.png[/img] to [i]Never install driver software from Windows Update[/i] [img]https://treexy.com/media/37943/sphere4_small.png[/img]. After you have changed this setting you will have to restart your computer for the changes to take effect.

[img]https://treexy.com/media/38040/disableautomaticupdates.png[/img]
[i]Changing how Windows driver updates are installed.[/i]

Unfortunately, some driver updates that are already discovered by Windows Update might still be installed after this change. This does not happen on every computer and you only need to continue with this guide in case a driver is still being installed without your consent. In order to prevent such drivers from being installed you can download the [i]Show or hide updates[/i] troubleshooter package from [url=http://download.microsoft.com/download/F/2/2/F22D5FDB-59CD-4275-8C95-1BE17BF70B21/wushowhide.diagcab]Microsoft[/url].

[img]https://treexy.com/media/38041/showorhideupdates.gif[/img]
[i]Using the show or hide updates troubleshooter from Microsoft.
[/i]

Once you have opened the troubleshooter, select [i]Advanced[/i] [img]https://treexy.com/media/37940/sphere1_small.png[/img], make sure [i]Apply repairs automatically[/i] is checked [img]https://treexy.com/media/37941/sphere2_small.png[/img] and select [i]Next[/i]. The next screen will ask you if you want to [i]Hide updates[/i] or [i]Show hidden updates[/i]. You should select the [i]Hide updates [/i][img]https://treexy.com/media/37942/sphere3_small.png[/img], unless you want to undo an update that you have hidden. The troubleshooter will now scan your computer for available updates and show you a list of updates that can be hidden [img]https://treexy.com/media/37943/sphere4_small.png[/img]. Make sure that you [i]only[/i] select driver updates and ignore all regular Windows updates. Even though the troubleshooter can hide these updates as well, we do not recommend this as regular updates often contain software and security fixes. Once you have selected the driver updates that you want to hide, click on [i]Next[/i] and then [i]Close[/i]. Even though it is not necessary for most computers, we recommend you to restart your computer. Future updates that are added to Windows Update should be hidden automatically by the change made in Driver Fusion.

You can also find this post on our [url=https://treexy.com/about/news/disable-automatic-driver-updates-in-windows-10/]website[/url].

Today, we are happy to announce that Driver Fusion 3.2 is now available for download. This release marks the beginning of improving driver family. More information can be found below.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list][*][i]Driver family - Community suggested feature[/i] - Added a lot of new driver family entries for AMD graphic cards, NVIDIA graphic cards and NVIDIA PhysX. Driver Fusion is now again able to detect and delete everything of importance that is installed by their installers.[/*][/list]
[b]Changed features:[/b]

[b]Resolved issues:[/b]
[list][*][i][img]https://treexy.com/media/19224/premium16x16.png[/img] Device control & health check[/i] - A backup of a driver with a WHQL signature could occasionally show an unverified driver message during installation due to files being included that did not belong to the driver.[/*][*][i][img]https://treexy.com/media/19224/premium16x16.png[/img] Device control & health check[/i] - A backup of a driver that linked to another driver could in some cases not include all necessary files.[/*][*][i][img]https://treexy.com/media/19224/premium16x16.png[/img] Device control[/i] - A couple of device and driver properties were never listed.[/*][*][i][img]https://treexy.com/media/19224/premium16x16.png[/img] Device control[/i] - Retrieving device and driver properties could occasionally cause Driver Fusion to freeze or close unintentionally.[/*][*][i][img]https://treexy.com/media/19224/premium16x16.png[/img] Device control[/i] - Messages could in some cases be shown with incorrect punctuation.[/*][/list]
For all Driver Fusion Premium users, your installation will update automatically.

notes.title: Driver Fusion 3.1 Update Released
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce Driver Fusion 3.1, which can be downloaded right now. This update comes with full support for the recently released Windows 10. More information can be found below.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Windows[/i] - Driver Fusion is now fully compatible with Windows 10.[/*]
[*][i]Localization[/i] - Added 5 new languages: Filipino (Philippines), Irish (Ireland), Sesotho sa Leboa (South Africa), Sinhalese (Sri Lanka), and Tajiki (Afghanistan and Tajikistan).[/*]
[*][i]Driver family - Community suggested feature[/i] - Added a driver family for Rivet Networking, the company behind products such as the Killer E2200 and Killer E2400.[/*]
[*][i]Driver family - Community suggested feature[/i] - The installed driver families option is now remembered. If you cancel while the installed driver families are loading, it will revert to all driver families.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Changed features:[/b]
[list]
[*][i][img]https://treexy.com/media/19224/premium16x16.png[/img] Device control & health check [/i]- Improved finding drivers, which increases the number of (outdated) drivers found on most systems.[/*]
[*][i][img]https://treexy.com/media/19224/premium16x16.png[/img] Device control[/i] - Improved the results and performance of device identifier.[/*]
[*][i][img]https://treexy.com/media/19224/premium16x16.png[/img] Monitor - Community suggested feature[/i] - Added support for the ITE IT8620E.[/*]
[*][i]Interface - Community suggested feature[/i] - Most controls will now regain focus after it has been lost due to loading content.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Resolved issues:[/b]
[list]
[*][i][img]https://treexy.com/media/19224/premium16x16.png[/img] Device control[/i] - Copying device or driver information to the clipboard could occasionally cause Driver Fusion to freeze or close unintentionally.[/*]
[*][i][img]https://treexy.com/media/19224/premium16x16.png[/img] Device control[/i] - Device overview could in some cases show unreadable device information.[/*]
[*][i][img]https://treexy.com/media/19224/premium16x16.png[/img] Device control[/i] - Unknown devices could in some cases be hidden from the user.[/*]
[*][i]Health check[/i] - Outdated drivers could occasionally find the driver that was already installed.[/*]
[*][i]Driver family[/i] - Deleting driver family entries could in some cases get stuck at 0%.[/*]
[*][i]Interface [/i]- The verification dialog screen could occasionally focus on the wrong control.[/*]
[*][i]Interface [/i]- The escape key did not always close the dialog screen.[/*]
[*][i]Interface [/i]- The tab key could occasionally focus on controls behind the dialog screen.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Driver Fusion 3.0 Update Released
notes.content:
We are delighted to announce that Driver Fusion 3.0 is available for download now. The most important change of this update is a redesigned menu based on the feedback we received. More information can be found below.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list][*][i]Interface - Community suggested feature -[/i] The menu has been redesigned to improve usability. It is now possible to go directly to each screen without having to select another tab first.[/*][*][i]Interface [/i]- Added a help button to go directly to the manual.[/*][/list]

[b]Changed features:[/b]
[list][*][i]Device control[/i] - Added a progress indicator while scanning for hardware devices.[*][i]Driver family[/i] - Improved caching of installed driver families.[/*][*][i]Driver family[/i] - The installed driver families will now automatically refresh after a delete operation.[/*][*][i]Driver family[/i] - Added a progress indicator while scanning for installed driver families.[/*][*][i]Driver family[/i] - History items are now saved even after cancelling the current operation.[/*][*][i]Interface[/i] - Improved the responsiveness of driver family.[/*][*][i]Interface[/i] - Improved font scaling of the notification bar.[/*][*][i]Interface[/i] - The scrollbar is no longer invisible when it is disabled.[/*][*][i]Interface[/i] - Many icon changes to clarify their function.[/*][*][i]Localization[/i] -[i][i] Community suggested feature -[/i][/i] Added right-to-left language support.[/*][*][i]Localization[/i] - Added Kazakh and Uzbek.[/*][/list]

[b]Resolved issues:[/b]
[list][*][i]Device control[/i] - Devices without compatible ids could occasionally cause Driver Fusion to freeze or close unintentionally.[/*][*][i]Device control -[/i] Changing between different sources in the driver backup install dialog could occasionally result in an empty title bar.[/*][*][i]Desktop[/i] - The user name was not stored correctly for all languages.[/*][*][i]Interface[/i] - A white line was occasionally rendered at the bottom of the window.[/*][*][i]Steam[/i] - The Tree Mulcher Steam achievement could occasionally cause Driver Fusion to close unintentionally.[/*][*][i]Filters[/i] - The new filter entry could also be added with cancel.[/*][*][i]Filters[/i] - Multiple filters with the same name could be added.[/*][*][i]Filters[/i] - Add new filter entry button could in some cases be visible without a selected filter.[/*][*][i]Driver family[/i] - Scanning for installed driver family entries could in some cases get stuck at 0%.[/*][/list]

Since last year we've been working a lot on improving the interface of Driver Fusion. Many parts of the interface, including the redesigned menu added in this update, are improved based on the suggestions we receive. Please continue to share your thoughts with us as this is important for us and the future of Driver Fusion. As with all updates, it's free for everyone to enjoy.

notes.title: Interface feedback needed
notes.content:
Since last year we've been working a lot on improving the interface of Driver Fusion. As a result are many parts of the interface improved based on the suggestions from the community.

The part we receive the most feedback on is the menu. Because we receive both positive and negative feedback on the menu, we would like to hear your opinion on it.

We've been working on a couple of variations on the menu and will show you some below.

On all screenshots, the icons are placeholders and do not represent the final idea. The blue color might also be changed (feedback is welcome).

On #3 and up you can also find a question button shown on the top of the screen. This button links towards the manual of that specific screen. This is planned for the upcoming version.

#1
[img]http://i.imgur.com/fHQpEXC.png[/img]
[i]The current menu, the hints shown.[/i]

#2
[img]http://i.imgur.com/LgOUqC6.png[/img]
[i]A menu on the left side, the hints shown.[/i]

#3 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/CL1dSba.png[/img]
[i]A menu on the left side, no hints. The most important hint is now shown as a tooltip when you hover over the menu.[/i]

#4 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/AGRs9GC.png[/img]
[i]A menu on the left side, no hints and a question icon where you can hover over (or click on) to describe the feature. This question icon is only shown when you hover over health check. Here, you can also find a settings icon on the bottom left instead of the top.[/i]

With this type of menu there is no longer a separation between the screens we use at the moment (maintenance, computer, management). We also made some variations with separation integrated:

#5
[img]http://i.imgur.com/gv7V2G9.png[/img]
[i]Implied separation, but not naming them.[/i]

#6
[img]http://i.imgur.com/xtSvdIK.png[/img]
[i]Separation with names.[/i]

#7
[img]http://i.imgur.com/vv0eMM0.png[/img]
[i]Separated by category, you first click on a category and then it expands to the different screens.[/i]

#8
[b]Your idea for another type of menu (or another variation on the screenshots above).[/b]

To just name a few questions we have:
[list]
[*]Should we change something in the menu? If so, what should it be changed into?
[*]Do you find the hints at the top of each screen useful and would you prefer to keep these hints as-is? Or would a tooltip be enough to describe the feature (with or without the large question button on top of the window)? 
[*]Is the separation of the screens (maintenance, computer, management) useful to you?
[*]Another idea we've had was that the question icon on top of the window had two options, one would be to go to the manual (as described above) and the other one would be to show the tooltips in a dialog. Is this something you see as an improvement?[/list]

You can leave your feedback on this announcement, in the discussion forums or [url=treexy.com/about/contact-us/]contact us[/url] through email. Please tell us about your opinion as your feedback is very important for us and the future of Driver Fusion.

notes.title: Driver Fusion 2.7 Update Released
notes.content:
Driver Fusion 2.7 has been released and is available for download. This release focuses on the new online service. Below you will find information regarding the old online service and the other changes.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*][i][Premium] Health check[/i] - Added a progress indicator to visualize the device that is currently being fixed.
[/list]
[b]Changed features:[/b]
[list]
[*][i][Premium] Health check[/i] - Improved the ordering of missing and outdated drivers.
[*][i]Desktop[/i] - Improved the performance of restoring the desktop icons.
[*][i]Settings[/i] - The settings are now automatically saved after every change instead of only on close.
[*][i]Service[/i] - The online service that allows you to gain access to several features, such as the automatic driver updated, has been completely rewritten. This new online service enables us to deploy new versions more easily without disrupting the service and is also more friendly to firewalls. The old online service will remain fully functional until February 1st, 2015. After this date only signing in with your email address and updating will remain functional for the old online service. As of Driver Fusion 2.7 the new online service will be used.
[/list]
[b]Resolved issues:[/b]
[list]
[*][i][Premium] Device control [/i]- Identify could in some cases not show any results.
[*][i][Premium] Device control [/i]- Reselecting a device could occasionally cause Driver Fusion to freeze or close unintentionally.
[*][i][Premium] Device control [/i]- The backed up driver text did not update after selecting another destination.
[*][i][Premium] Device control [/i]- Changing the sort order of online drivers could in some cases cause Driver Fusion to freeze or close unintentionally.
[*][i]Desktop [/i]- Desktop icons could in some cases not restore to the correct location.

notes.title: Driver Fusion 2.2 Update Released
notes.content:
Driver Fusion 2.2 has been released and is available for download or update within Driver Fusion. This release features multiple performance improvements, improved health check results, and a more responsive interface. See below for a full list of all the changes made.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*][i][Premium] Interface[/i] - Health check and driver family now show progress in the taskbar of Windows 7 and higher.
[*][i][Premium] Health check[/i] - The tooltip of the driver now includes the Windows error message when the driver install fails.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Added a driver backup failed message in case the backup failed.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - The message shown when a driver install fails now includes the Windows error message.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Added the authenticode information of the driver to driver overview.
[*][i][Premium] Device control - Community suggested feature[/i] - You can now also backup online drivers instead of only installed drivers. This enables you to download a driver without being forced to immediately install the driver.
[*][i][Premium] Settings - Community suggested feature[/i] - A new setting has been added so that a minimum driver signature can be selected for the drivers that are downloadable through health check or device control. The available options are none, signed, authenticode verified by a trusted publisher, authenticode, and WHQL.
[*][i]Driver families[/i] - Added new categories and devices with a lot of new driver family entries to clean, such as devices and peripherals from Razer, Mad Catz, Synaptics, Dell, Epson, Lexmark, Kyocera, Brother and Canon. The existing driver families also have been greatly improved by adding a large number of new driver family entries.
[*][i]Interface[/i] - All screens are now loaded asynchronous and do not block the user interface anymore during loading.
[*][i]Interface[/i] - Longer lasting tasks, such as the health check and driver family scan, can now be cancelled.
[*][i]Filters[/i] - Added a filter to show custom, existing or all filters.
[*][i]Localization[/i] - Added 11 new languages: Chinese (Traditional, Taiwan) with special thanks to D. Hsieh, Yoruba (Nigeria), Punjabi (India), Nepali (Nepal), Maori (New Zealand), Lao (Lao P.D.R.), Khmer (Cambodia), Igbo (Nigeria), Hausa (Latin, Nigeria), Bosnian (Latin, Bosnia and Herzegovina), Mongolian (Cyrillic, Mongolia), and Marathi (India).
[*][i]Health check[/i] - The tooltip of the driver now includes the provider, release date, version, and signature.
[*][i]Health check[/i] - Changed the cursor of the driver backup destination icon to a pointer to better indicate that it is clickable.
[/list]
[b]Changed features:[/b]
[list]
[*][i][Premium] Health check[/i] - Drivers with a lower version number than the installed driver are now also allowed to be installed. This is especially useful when the older driver, such as the default Microsoft driver, has a higher version number than the newer driver shipped by the vendor.
[*][i][Premium] Health check[/i] - Increased the amount of drivers that can be downloaded for missing and outdated drivers through improved matching.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Changed the color for missing devices and missing drivers in the colored bar.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Improved the overall detection rate of device identifier by including the compatible ids of the device.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - The installed driver filter is now always located at the right side of the screen for consistency.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Improved and the naming scheme and performance of backup.
[*][i][Premium] Interface[/i] - Renamed location at driver backup to destination to make it similar to health check.
[*][i]Treexy account[/i] - It is now possible to register and sign in using your email address instead of a username. The existing usernames are no longer required and will be removed in the future. Remembered account details (if enabled) will automatically use your email address the next time you sign in.
[*][i]Treexy account[/i] - Improved handling of sign in and sign out so that users have less chance of waiting for the server to reset existing sessions that are not closed correctly.
[*][i]Interface[/i] - The filters and history data grid now automatically scrolls to the top when changing the selected item.
[*][i]Interface[/i] - Screens that have success messages (such as resend email or reset password) now show a green notification upon success.
[*][i]Interface[/i] - All dialog screens are now the same size.
[/list]
[b]Resolved issues:[/b]
[list]
[*][i][Premium] Health check[/i] - Updated the translations to give a more meaningful warning message. For example, no more driver install confirmation warning is given when only a driver backup is created.
[*][i][Premium] Product activation[/i] - The upgrade to premium label was not immediately hidden after license activation.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Devices could in some cases not show any driver information even though there was a driver installed.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Removing a backup in install driver did not refresh the content correctly.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Install driver asked to select the online driver to install when the only available driver was hidden due to the active filter setting.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Switching between the results of device identifier no longer has a delay.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Reboot notifications could in some cases not show.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - The view all filter did not show phantom devices.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - The current search query was not reapplied after performing a scan.
[*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - The state of related devices did not refresh when enabling or disabling a device that influences the state of related devices. For example, Bluetooth devices are usually related to a couple of other devices.
[*][i][Premium] Device control & health check[/i] - Driver backup could in some cases not detect all existing backups correctly.
[*][i][Premium] Device control & health check[/i] - The last used backup destination was not remembered correctly between device control and health check.
[*][i]Interface[/i] - Localized dates were not displayed in accordance with the regional settings of Windows.
[*][i]Interface[/i] - White pixels and lines shown on top of the window.
[*][i]Interface[/i] - Inconsistent alignment of the text in the there are no items available entry.
[*][i]Interface[/i] - Very slow sorting of columns in data grids with a large number of entries.
[*][i]Driver family[/i] - The types of the driver families were not translated.
[*][i]Health check[/i] - The first group in health check shifted up a few pixels as soon as the scrollbar appeared.
[*][i]Health check[/i] - The animation of collapsing a group in health check could sometimes flicker.
[*][i]Starting/closing[/i] - Unintentional closing due to invalid window positions being used to restore the window to.
[*][i]Starting/closing[/i] - Sorting entries could in some cases, especially during an active scan, cause Driver Fusion to close unintentionally.
[/list]

notes.title: Driver Fusion 2.1 Update Released
notes.content:
Version 2.1 of Driver Fusion is available for download or update within Driver Fusion. This release brings a fresh new look and more colorful design to the entire interface. We've also made the analysis feature, to find missing or outdated drivers on your system, available to free users after popular demand. Driver Fusion 2.1 also contains many other improvements. For a list of all changes, consult the full release notes below.

[b]New features:[/b]
     [list][*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - You can now search for a device name to make it easier to find specific devices.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Devices now show their own device icon instead of the device status icon. A colored bar, that represents the current device status, is now shown to the left of the device.
    [*][i]Health check - Community suggested feature -[/i] The analysis feature, such as finding all missing or outdated drivers on your system, is now available to free users. A premium license is required to download and install these drivers, or to create a backup of all drivers. [/list] 
[b]Changed features:[/b]
     [list][*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Driver backups now store signature information in the backup information file (.3xy).
    [*][i]Health check - Community suggested feature[/i] - The last used backup location is now remembered. The backup location is also added to the backup locations of driver backup in device control.
    [*][i]Health check[/i] - Improved the algorithm for finding both missing and outdated drivers.
    [*][i]Interface[/i] - Health check is now the default screen when opening Driver Fusion.
    [*][i]Interface[/i] - The notification bar now automatically scales the text size in relation to the available space.
    [*][i]Interface[/i] - The menu has been redesigned to make it clearer and easier to use.
    [*][i]Interface[/i] - Slightly reduced the width of the resize grip on the edges of the window to make scrollbars easier to use.
    [*][i]Interface[/i] - On Windows Vista and higher, the native folder dialog is now used instead of the previous used folder dialog.
    [*][i]Manual[/i] - The manual shipped with the installer has been removed and replaced by an online manual. [/list] 
[b]Resolved issues:[/b]
     [list][*][i][Premium] Device control[/i] - Selecting a device could occasionally select the parent of the device.
    [*][i]Health check[/i] - Performing a driver backup could in some cases freeze Driver Fusion.
    [*][i]Health check[/i] - Scanning for outdated drivers could in some cases freeze Driver Fusion.
    [*][i]Health check[/i] - A missing or outdated driver installation would sometimes fail to install.
    [*][i]Starting/closing[/i] - Several issues that caused Driver Fusion to close unintentionally. [/list]

notes.title: Driver Fusion 2.0 Update Released
notes.content:
This new release contains the most requested feature for Driver Fusion, namely an automatic driver updater! This feature can be found in health check under maintenance, together with the ability to automatically create a backup of all drivers. Driver Fusion 2.0 also contains many other improvements and resolved issues. Below you will find the release notes containing the other changes.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]    [*][i][Premium] Health check - Community suggested feature -[/i] Health check analyses your computer's health and helps you to easily fix the detected issues. Its automatic driver updater is ideal for installing missing or newer drivers without having to worry about technical details. You can also use health check to create a backup of all installed drivers at once.
    [*][i][Premium] Driver backup & online - Community suggested feature -[/i] The installed driver version is now displayed to easily distinguish between the different driver versions.
    [*][i][Premium] Driver backup & online - Community suggested feature -[/i] Added a filter to hide the installed driver version from the available drivers that can be installed.
    [*][i][Premium] Driver backup & online - Community suggested feature -[/i] The installed driver version and the backed up driver version (if any) is now displayed.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] Driver files now includes the information file (.inf) and catalog file (.cat) from the installed driver.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] Driver backups are now stored in an easy to understand folder name by including the device name and driver version.
    [*][i][Premium] Device identifier -[/i] Increased the amount of devices that can be identified as a result of multiple inquiries per device.
    [*][i]Filters -[/i] You can now use a file and directory browser to make it easier to select a file or directory.
[/list]

[b]Changed features:[/b]
[list]    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] Improved the performance of retrieving device and driver information.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] Driver backups now store more data in the backup information file (.3xy) to improve filtering for devices.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] Driver files now automatically wrap the text when it exceeds the available width.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] It is now possible to enable and disable devices with encountered problems.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] Improved the performance of loading all devices by about 800%. This is especially noticeable on Windows XP and Windows Vista.
    [*][i][Premium] Monitor -[/i] The interface is no longer disabled during initial loading of the screen. Loading is now also immediately finished when visiting the monitor screen again.
    [*][i][Premium] Interface -[/i] In case of a network problem, the premium status is now only reset when going to another screen. This allows the user to continue with their current screen even though online features will be out of order due to the network problem.
    [*][i]History -[/i] The interface is no longer disabled during initial loading of the screen.
    [*][i]Interface -[/i] Improved the overall responsiveness of Driver Fusion.
    [*][i]Interface -[/i] The file sizes of empty files are now displayed as 0 KB instead of 0 B.
    [*][i]Settings -[/i] Renamed messages, located in the general section, to protection.
    [*][i]Settings -[/i] The system restore setting is now located under protection in the general section.
    [*][i]System protection -[/i] On Windows 8, system protection is now always executed regardless of the age of a previous restore point. This is now consistent with the behaviour from previous Windows versions.
    [*][i]Steam -[/i] Removed Steam Community Overlay integration as it was disabled by Valve.
[/list]

[b]Resolved issues:[/b]
[list]    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] On Windows XP, a driver backup could in some cases not find a catalog file.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] On Windows Vista, driver information would sometimes be empty.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] On Windows Vista, a driver could in some cases not be downloaded.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] A driver backup was not saving the backup information file (.3xy) when the backup location was changed. This prevented Driver Fusion from automatically detecting the created backups.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] Several dates, such as the driver release date, were not displayed in accordance with the regional settings of Windows.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] Very short button flickering when selecting a different device.
    [*][i][Premium] Device control -[/i] The backup and uninstall buttons were still visible when there was no driver installed.
    [*][i]Product activation -[/i] Adding an existing Driver Fusion Premium product code displayed the incorrect error message.
    [*][i]Starting/closing -[/i] Several issues that caused Driver Fusion to close unintentionally.
    [*][i]Steam -[/i] Fixed an issue with the Steam build that caused Driver Fusion to randomly close immediately after starting.
[/list]

notes.title: Driver Fusion Update Released
notes.content:
Version 1.7.0 is here! This release of Driver Fusion focuses on improving the interface and user experience. The release notes below contain more specific details about the updates, changes and fixes that Driver Fusion 1.7.0 introduces.

New features:
Driver family - Driver inspection and driver overview have been combined into a single completely redesigned screen named driver family (named driver family because all driver versions are combined into one group, e.g. AMD display drivers). The redesigned interface includes a more spacious layout, icons and better navigation.
Category view - Instead of listing all drivers the driver family screen just shows the categories. This makes it easier to find the driver that you want to delete instead of having to search through the list of all driver families.
Details view - This view provides the list of all driver families just like you were used to but now with the new design of the driver family screen.
Notification bar - Hints and notifications have been combined into one simple notification bar at the top of the screen.
Steam - If you use Driver Fusion on Steam you can now launch Driver Fusion without having the Steam client running. To do so you need to run the Driver Fusion executable with the parameter "-nosteam" (without the quotes).
Hint navigation - It is now possible to pause hints. Previous and next buttons can be used to browse all the hints manually.
[Premium] Installed filter - Driver overview has been integrated with the new driver family screen. Installed drivers can now be filtered from the complete list by selecting the option to only show installed drivers.

Changed features:
No items available - Added an empty item text to lists that do not contain any items yet.
Manual and credits - Buttons have been added to the general settings to open the manual and view the credits screen.
Updated hints - Most of the texts have been updated, this also includes several new tooltips.
Verification - Resend verification will now return the user to the verification screen instead of returning to the main Driver Fusion window.
Multi removal - It is no longer possible to select multiple driver families by default. Experienced users can re-enable the selection of multiple driver families in the cleaning settings.
Progress indication - Backup and removal of driver family entries now indicates its progress in percentages.
[Premium] Monitor - Support has been added for more hardware. This includes Samsung SSDs, Intel Haswell and AMD Jaguar CPUs.
[Premium] Device control - Device control has been moved to the maintenance section instead of the computer section.
[Premium] Device driver backup - Backups made with device control now better adhere to the file structure as originally defined by the vendors.

Resolved issues:
Horizontal scrolling - Improved horizontal scrolling support, fixing certain settings being partially unreadable on small window sizes and devices having unnecessary horizontal scrollbars in device control.
Desktop backup - Fixed desktop backup showing ‘0 icons’.
Faulty log - Fixed a potential crash on Windows Vista when trying to load a corrupted log in the log screen.
[Premium] In-app update - Temporary update files would sometimes not be deleted. Driver Fusion now checks on startup if all temporary files from the last update were deleted properly.
[Premium] Device driver backup - Some files would not be incorporated in the restore procedure due to incorrect naming.
